Thanks Laura / Daniel — quick technical take from my side before Vivek provides the formal answer.

Short answer: the control owner depends on deployment mode.
- Hosted (Redwood API): Redwood manages encryption at rest and in transit; keys are Redwood-managed. Control owner: Redwood Inference Security.
- Dedicated (customer-dedicated pools we operate in our cloud): typically we offer BYOK (customer imports keys) or Redwood-managed keys; control owner can be either depending on contract and key provider (KMS/HSM).
- Private (VPC / on-prem): customer typically retains key management entirely; Redwood can integrate but doesn't have custody unless contractually agreed.

Open questions for the SIG response:
1) Does Acme want a single consolidated statement that explains the conditional nature?
2) If so, do you prefer the wording to default to the "most secure" posture (i.e., assume customer manages keys) or to list separate answers per deployment?

I've attached an evidence mapping I've started (local copy) that lists sample artifacts for Hosted vs Dedicated/BYOK vs Private. Happy to refine with Vivek.

Hi Daniel — thanks for the call this morning. Below is Redwood's formal interpretation you can paste into the SIG response, followed by the recommended evidence artifacts Acme may attach. This language is intentionally concise to satisfy SIG reviewers while accurately representing responsibility boundaries.

Formal responder text (single-line):
"Redwood Inference: For Hosted API deployments, Redwood manages encryption keys used to protect customer data (Redwood controls key management). For Dedicated or Private deployments where customer-provided keys (BYOK) are used, the customer retains key ownership and management responsibility unless an alternate contractual arrangement is specified."

Clarifying note (one sentence):
"In Dedicated/Private BYOK configurations, Redwood integrates with customer KMS/HSM for cryptographic operations; Redwood does not retain custody of customer private keys unless explicitly contracted to do so."

- KMS integration guide (dedicated/BYOK) — configuration steps showing integration points.
